subject: Cancel monthly donation - from Canada
originalBody:
Hello

I just realized that I can't claim charity tax benefits if I donate directly to you as I am a Canadian citizen without US income.

So I would like to please cancel my monthly donations going forward. Instead I will donate to:

https://www.can
draftBody:
Dear Katie,

Thank you so much for your continued generosity and for being a monthly supporter of the Panzi Foundation — your contributions truly make a difference.

We completely understand, and we appreciate you sharing this with us. We have forwarded your cancellation request and your question about giving from Canada to our Director of Development, Stephanie Rapp, who will follow up with you directly to confirm the cancellation and provide guidance on the best way to continue supporting our work as a Canadian donor.

Thank you again for your kindness and your commitment to the Panzi Foundation's mission. We are grateful for your support in any form it takes.

With gratitude,
The Panzi Foundation Team
